en: The image is a vintage postcard featuring two black-and-white photographs. The left photo shows a European city street with a large, ornate building on a curved road, some pedestrians, and an old automobile, suggesting an early 20th-century setting. The right photo depicts a garden scene with three people (two women and one man) sitting at a table under trees, possibly in a café or private garden. The two photos are separated by a floral illustration, typical for decorative postcards of the period.
